definitions.counting: 41 historical command spellings: 39 canonical commands, one alias (alerts), one retired command (metrics).
definitions.implementation_status: planned means absent; omitted means deliberately excluded; implemented_unqualified means client behavior is implemented, with evidence and limits in its command documentation. Applicable target/company qualification remains required. App owners, catalog and roadmap are implemented separately from this historical inventory.
definitions.day2_support: Public platform references identify the reviewed source; they do not establish qualified hosted support or live provider readiness.
definitions.proposed_command: Proposed Day 2 UX, subject to the reviewed integration boundary. These strings are documentation, not executable next_actions.
definitions.disposition: adapt uses an existing foundation; redesign changes auth/UX; reimplement uses Rust; replace uses Roc app conventions; needs-service requires a hosted/provider contract; instance-extension is optional; consolidate maps an alias to one command; omit excludes retirement.
definitions.publication: Generalized public use cases only. Private source locations, parser metadata, company endpoints and operational implementation details are intentionally excluded.
